description: Human iPSC-derived cortical neurons expressing APOE ε4; comparator genotype, isogenic status, line identity and assay details not given in abstract (abstract-only). TRPML1 activated pharmacologically, presumably with ML-SA1, and endolysosomal Ca2+ release measured. Caveat: neurons rather than astrocytes; the readout is endolysosomal Ca2+ release, not endosomal pH.

provenance.excerpt: We reveal that induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived human cortical neurons expressing APOE ε4, the strongest genetic risk factor for LOAD, have significantly diminished TRPML1-induced endolysosomal Ca2+ release.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (reduced TRPML1 activity) -> (diminished TRPML1-induced endolysosomal Ca2+ release in iPSC-derived cortical neurons); pH not measured
